basics.name: Luis Sánchez Elvira
basics.role: L1/L2 IT support and junior developer
basics.summary: Two years of L1/L2 support at Telefónica Tech and the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. I finish my Computer Engineering degree in 2027 and I am looking for a role in systems or development.
basics.headline: Systems, support and code.

about: I have over two years of experience in L1/L2 IT support. At Minsait I resolved 10 to 15 L2 incidents a day for Telefónica Tech, with SLA compliance above 95%. At Ibermática I supported more than 1,000 users at the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in a high-security environment.
I have also worked in web development with ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript and SQL Server, maintaining and extending internal applications in production.
I like building things that work and understanding why the ones that don't are failing. This site, for example, is hosted by me.
